test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate** ANTONYM **of the given word.

Vulnerable
solution:
The correct answer is **"Secure"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Vulnerable- **able to be easily physically or mentally hurt, influenced, or attacked

 
 
• **Example- **I felt very vulnerable, standing there without any clothes on.
 
 
 
• **Secure- **positioned or fixed firmly and correctly and therefore not likely to move, fall, or break
 
 
• **Example- **That ladder doesn't look very secure to me.
 
 
 
• **Breakable- **Something that is breakable might easily break
 
 
• **Example- **Do you have anything breakable in your bag?
 
 
 
• **Tender- **gentle, loving, or kind
 
 
• **Example- **What you need is some tender loving care.
 
 
 
• **Sensitive- **easily upset by the things people say or do, or causing people to be upset, embarrassed, or angry
 
 
• **Example- **Her reply showed that she was very sensitive to criticism.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is **Option 1 i.e. Secure.**
